mechanism_narrative: FGFR1 (RTK) and OSMR (cytokine receptor) are forced into proximity by a rigid_helix_20 linker (~30 Å). FGFR1's kinase domain transphosphorylates OSMR's intracellular domain, creating docking sites for GRB2/SHC1/FRS2/GAB1/PIK3R1, while OSMR-associated JAK1/JAK2 transphosphorylate FGFR1, recruiting STAT3. The short rigid linker sterically excludes PLCG1/PLCG2 (large SH2-SH2-SH3 adaptors requiring ~60+ Å spacing). The biased output is MAPK/ERK + PI3K/AKT + JAK/STAT3 signaling without PLCγ/Ca²⁺, shifting aged muscle toward a young transcriptional phenotype (up: contractile/structural genes; down: IEGs/aged markers).
